meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用约束模型计算代谢网络通量,预测基因敲除带来的影响
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用约束模型研究代谢网络、做通量或基因敲除分析。
copy.tagline_en: Model metabolic networks to compute fluxes and predict gene knockout effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study metabolic networks with constraint-based models.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Python 的 COBRApy 加载或构建代谢模型(SBML、JSON、YAML),跑 FBA、FVA、基因敲除、通量采样等计算,并给出通量、生长速率等模拟结果。
howto.when: 当你要求做基于约束的代谢建模分析时,比如加载或导出 SBML 模型、跑 FBA 或 FVA、做基因/反应敲除筛选等。

say.text: 加载 textbook 模型跑一次 FBA,告诉我生长速率
say.note: 返回目标值与求解状态

say.text: 对这个模型做单基因敲除,列出必需基因
say.note: 输出各基因敲除后的生长

say.text: 算 FVA,给我 90% 最优下的通量范围

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use Python's COBRApy to load or build metabolic models (SBML, JSON, YAML) and run FBA, FVA, gene knockouts and flux sampling, returning fluxes, growth rates and other simulation results.
howto.when_en: When you ask for constraint-based metabolic modeling: loading or exporting SBML models, running FBA or FVA, or gene/reaction knockout screens.

say_en.text: Load the textbook model and run FBA; tell me the growth rate
Run single gene deletions on this model and list essential genes
Run FVA and give me flux ranges at 90% optimum
